visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: FizzBuzz
visualizerParams.description: Type the classic FizzBuzz for 1 to 15: multiples of 3 say Fizz, multiples of 5 say Buzz and multiples of both say FizzBuzz. The check for both must come first.

checks.label: The list is right
checks.expr: text('#out') === '1 2 Fizz 4 Buzz Fizz 7 8 Fizz Buzz 11 Fizz 13 14 FizzBuzz'
